name: Antigravity
description: Dev agent skills, terminal control, and workspace management for Antigravity.

capabilities.name: Run Shell Command
capabilities.intent: Execute a shell command in the Antigravity terminal.
capabilities.script: Execute the user's shell command in the active Antigravity workspace.

capabilities.name: List Workspaces
capabilities.intent: Show active Antigravity workspaces and their current directories.
capabilities.script: List all active Antigravity terminal workspaces with their working directories.

capabilities.name: Git Status
capabilities.intent: Show the git status of the workspace's repository.
capabilities.script: Run git status in the current workspace directory.

capabilities.name: Open Project
capabilities.intent: Open a project directory in a new Antigravity workspace.
capabilities.script: Open the specified directory in a new Antigravity workspace tab.

cli_tools.name: agy
cli_tools.description: Antigravity CLI for workspace and agent control.

mcp_servers.name: antigravity
mcp_servers.description: Antigravity MCP server for terminal and workspace operations.
